name: Sariya Rizwan
summary: I build the data pipelines, models and dashboards that operations teams make decisions with. At PSEG I built Fleet Forecaster, which cut fleet-planning runs from 6 hours to 5 minutes and saves about $120K a year. Today I own six analytics workstreams at Natera, from Voice of Patient to Twilio/Calabrio reconciliation.
